9b4ea6043415074a.description: We are seeking a high-caliber Senior System Analyst to join our team. You will bridge business stakeholders, project leadership, architects, and delivery teams for a large-scale digital integration program. You will translate business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear functional and technical requirements across integration services, event streaming, the developer portal, reporting, and operations. You will also coordinate interface requirements with the AI engineering workstream, while AI model design, development, and training remain outside this role. The ideal candidate is a native Arabic speaker with excellent English fluency and strong command of the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). · Requirements Engineering: Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, analyze, validate, and trace functional and non-functional requirements for the non-AI project scope. · System Analysis & Documentation: Produce BRDs, SRS, functional and technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface requirements, data mappings, and analysis documents for integration services and event topics. · Process & Integration Modeling: Document current- and future-state processes, gap analyses, workflows, sequence diagrams, system interactions, APIs, integration mappings, and data flows. · Requirements Lifecycle & Governance: Maintain traceability, backlog readiness, change requests, priorities, dependencies, and alignment with security, data, service-level, and technical governance requirements. · Validation & Acceptance Support: Define acceptance criteria and test scenarios; collaborate with QA on integration, performance, and UAT activities; and verify delivered services against approved requirements. · Cross-Functional Delivery & AI Coordination: Work with integration, portal, event-streaming, operations, cybersecurity, data-governance, and AI teams; define AI-related interfaces and data requirements without owning AI model design, development, or training; and support handover and knowledge transfer. Required Qualifications · Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. · Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Analysis, including enterprise integration or digital transformation projects. · Process & Tool Proficiency: o Strong expertise in requirements engineering, stakeholder facilitation, functional and non-functional analysis, traceability, and change management. o Hands-on experience with requirements, backlog, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and MS Visio (or similar). o Deep understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum delivery, including documentation, testing, UAT, and release-readiness activities. · Data & Technical Skills: o Strong working knowledge of APIs, web services, system interfaces, data mapping, integration patterns, and event-driven systems. o Practical knowledge of databases, SQL, JSON, XML, interface specifications, and secure system-integration concepts. · Communication & Domain Knowledge: o Native Arabic speaker with excellent English fluency (written and spoken). o Ability to explain complex system behavior, dependencies, and technical requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. o Familiarity with KSA digital transformation, cybersecurity, data-governance, and regulatory environments is a strong plus. · Professional Attributes: o Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate complex requirements, identify gaps, and support viable system solutions. o Proven ability to work across business, architecture, development, QA, operations, security, data, and AI workstreams. o High attention to detail, clear ownership of requirements, and commitment to meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Employment Details · Location: Remote. · Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week).

9b8df19c03f38c90.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking an experienced UAT Testing Lead – Capital Markets to manage and govern User Acceptance Testing activities. This full-time role involves overseeing UAT across various Capital Markets platforms, including Trading, Treasury, Asset Management, Investment Banking, Custody, and Post-Trade systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong functional knowledge of Capital Markets instruments and processes, coupled with extensive experience in managing UAT programs within the financial services sector. Key Responsibilities Lead and govern end-to-end User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities across Capital Markets applications and platforms. Develop and maintain UAT strategies, test plans, test scenarios, test cases, execution schedules, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate testing activities with business users, trading, treasury, operations, risk, compliance, technology teams, and external vendors. Manage UAT for Trading Platforms, Treasury Management Systems (TMS), Order Management Systems (OMS), and Settlement/Clearing systems. Design and review complex business test scenarios covering Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives. Validate front-to-back Capital Markets workflows, including trade capture, order management, execution, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, and post-trade processing. Ensure testing activities align with applicable SAMA and CMA regulatory requirements. Manage defect identification, tracking, prioritization, triage, resolution, and retesting. Lead defect triage sessions and coordinate root-cause analysis with business and technical teams. Build and maintain Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM) to ensure appropriate requirements coverage. Establish structured UAT governance, testing controls, reporting standards, and quality gates. Track UAT progress, test coverage, defect status, risks, dependencies, and overall testing readiness. Prepare Go/No-Go assessments, UAT sign-off reports, dashboards, and management reporting. Escalate critical testing risks, dependencies, and blockers to relevant stakeholders. Support release readiness and ensure business acceptance criteria are met before production deployment. Drive continuous improvement across UAT processes, governance, quality assurance, and testing standards. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Strong hands-on experience with Capital Markets testing and quality assurance. Proficiency in testing Trading platforms, Treasury Management Systems (TMS), Order Management Systems (OMS), and Settlement/Clearing systems. In-depth knowledge of trade lifecycle and post-trade processing. Functional knowledge of Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives, Treasury, Trading, Asset Management, Investment Banking, Custody, and Post-Trade. Experience in test strategy, test planning, test scenario, and test case design. Competence in Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), defect management, defect triage, and root-cause analysis. Experience with UAT governance, sign-off, and Go/No-Go reporting. Knowledge of regulatory and compliance testing, including SAMA and CMA requirements. Experience with testing and management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, and Azure DevOps. Preferred Qualifications ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification. Experience supporting large-scale Capital Markets transformation or modernization programs. Experience with digital investment or electronic trading platforms. Experience with regulatory-driven testing within banking or financial services. Experience working with multiple technology vendors and complex system integrations. Experience preparing and presenting UAT readiness and Go/No-Go recommendations to senior stakeholders.

9b2d53dd86aacf4a.description: About Petromin Corporation Petromin Corporation is seeking a General Manager Internal Audit to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for providing independent and objective assurance and advisory functions to the Board and executive management. Role Purpose and Context The General Manager Internal Audit leads the function responsible for delivering risk-based assurance on the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control. This position ensures the independence and objectivity of Internal Audit, promotes conformance with the Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS 2024), and strengthens the control environment to support strategic objectives, governance maturity, and capital-markets readiness where applicable. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain a risk-based annual and multi-year audit plan aligned with the enterprise risk profile and strategy, securing Audit Committee approval and ensuring adequate resourcing. Direct the execution of financial, operational, compliance, IT, and governance audits, ensuring engagements are evidence-based, well-supervised, and lead to sound conclusions. Protect the independence of the function and the objectivity of auditors, escalating any impairment to the Audit Committee and ensuring management owns remediation of findings. Report significant findings, root causes, and agreed management actions to the Audit Committee, assessing management responses and tracking timely closure of audit observations. Administer the Audit Committee, including agendas, meeting packs, minutes, and the annual meeting calendar, ensuring alignment with corporate governance regulations. Establish and maintain the Quality Assurance & Improvement Program (QAIP), including internal assessments and periodic External Quality Assessment (EQA), driving GIAS 2024 conformance. Own and periodically refresh the Internal Audit Charter, ensuring conformance with GIAS, the Code of Ethics, and applicable regulatory expectations. Provide consulting and advisory input on the design of controls and governance without assuming management responsibility or impairing future independence. Coordinate with external auditors, regulators, and the second line to optimize assurance coverage and avoid duplication. Recruit, develop, and retain audit talent, managing performance and embedding continuous professional development and relevant certification. Advance the use of data analytics and audit/GRC tooling to improve coverage, efficiency, and insight. Performance Indicators Approved audit plan completion rate. Percentage of audit observations closed within agreed timelines, validated by Internal Audit. QAIP maturity and External Quality Assessment (EQA) conformance rating. Audit Committee and executive stakeholder satisfaction. Quality of engagement files (supervisory review, evidence, rating consistency). Team certification, capability, and retention metrics. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic environment focused on strengthening governance and risk management frameworks.

9b83476bff71fdda.description: About the Role Aviagen is seeking a Health Safety & Environment (HSE) Engineer to support the implementation and monitoring of HSE requirements across project sites in Sakaka, Dawmat Al Jandal, and Miguwa within the Al Jawf Region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves close collaboration with Project Management and site teams to ensure safe project delivery. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor the Project HSE Plan, adhering to Saudi HSE and Civil Defense requirements. Conduct regular site inspections to identify unsafe acts, conditions, and non-conformities, tracking and verifying corrective actions. Monitor the safe execution of high-risk activities, including excavation, work at height, lifting operations, electrical works, hot work, and confined space activities. Oversee the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system, ensuring proper procedures, risk assessments, and controls are in place. Frequent travel between project sites will be necessary. The role involves exposure to construction, agricultural, industrial, and infrastructure project environments, combining field inspections, safety monitoring, and office-based reporting. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

9bdcf25e06b6e2eb.description: Shipa Delivery is an online platform that makes it easier for businesses and consumers to send and receive parcels within the GCC. Our expanding operation connects users with a network of delivery assets and services via mobile apps and online business dashboards. We make collection of packages within one hour a reality, along with a choice of on-demand, same-day, next-day, and cross-border delivery services. Shipa Delivery’s technology stack provides real-time parcel tracking via GPS; and for businesses, an integrated solution to streamline last-mile logistics and automate delivery management. We celebrate versatile and self-driven candidates. We need you to be obsessed with customer engagement and be a force of evolution to make us better every day. Our culture is all about speed and care. Role Summary: The primary role of the Customs Clearance Specialist is you will manage the customs documentation and compliance processes for international shipments. You will coordinate with customs authorities, carriers, and other parties to ensure timely clearance of goods, minimizing delays and ensuring all necessary paperwork is properly completed. You will also stay updated on customs regulations and trade laws to ensure the business remains compliant with local and international trade rules. Responsibilities include but not limited to: · Customs Documentation: Prepare and process all customs documentation, including import/export declarations, commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other relevant paperwork. · Compliance: Ensure compliance with all applicable customs laws, regulations, and trade agreements, as well as company policies. · Customs Clearance Process: Submit customs declarations to customs authorities and ensure timely clearance of goods to avoid delays or fines. · Liaison with Customs Authorities: Act as the primary point of contact between customs authorities, shipping companies, and the company to resolve any customs issues or discrepancies. · Tariff Classification & Duties: Calculate and verify customs duties, tariffs, and taxes, ensuring accuracy and minimizing costs. · Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all customs documents and transactions. · Problem Resolution: Address and resolve any issues or delays related to customs clearance, including working with customs brokers or third-party service providers. · Consultation & Advice: Provide guidance to internal teams or clients regarding import/export regulations, classification of goods, and documentation requirements. Risk Management: Identify potential risks in the customs clearance process, such as non-compliance or delays, and take proactive measures to mitigate these risks. Your Qualifications Bachelor’s degree preferably in logistics and supply chain management Minimum 4 years of Customs Clearance or Cross Border experience required. Experience in or exposure to logistics and ecommerce, preferred. Your Proficiencies Team Player, strong interpersonal skills. Work well under pressure in a fast-paced and professional environment. Strong analytical and technical skills Knowledge in strategic planning Flexibility and willingness to do physical work and rotational shifts

9b59fa72e656b78d.description: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. This role is responsible for establishing our regional presence, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving the commercial adoption of humanoid robotics across enterprise, industrial, logistics, manufacturing, government, and public sector markets. Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care. Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings. Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office. Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics. Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

Good understanding of drainage networks, stormwater systems, culverts, hydraulic structures, and flood control infrastructure.
